title: Un-pin the FAB-always-visible-at-cap UX bug in manage_learners_screen_l1_test.dart or file it with a Linear id

evidence.quote: // BUG: ManageLearnersScreen does not visually disable the FAB or show

why: The test's own comment names this a UX bug ('the FAB should be disabled or hidden at cap') yet asserts the current buggy behavior (findsOneWidget) as passing, with no Linear id anywhere nearby. Anyone who fixes the FAB-cap UX later has to know to come back and flip this specific assertion; nothing links the comment to a backlog item, so the gap is invisible to grooming and easy to forget, unlike a tracked TODO.
recommendation: Either give the comment a DNI-#### id and keep the test as an explicit characterization test, or mark it skip: 'DNI-####' with the desired (not current) assertion as a red regression test.
acceptance_criteria: The FAB-cap gap has a Linear id referenced in the test file
No 'BUG:' comment describing unfixed product behavior remains without an adjacent DNI-#### id in this file
